name: Balkrishna Industries Ltd
title: Balkrishna Industries Ltd-$ - 502355 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Q1 FY27 OHT volume up 16% YoY to 93,770 MT with EBITDA margin down to 20.61% on raw material inflation; ~5% price hike with further hikes unannounced, and ₹3,000 cr capex balance still on schedule.

capex.quote: All the balance capex projects which are amounting to approximately INR3,000 crores are progressing as per schedule.

triggers.label: Price hike ~5% taken in Q1
triggers.quote: we have taken on a price hike of about 5% scattered across the various parts of the quarter, you will see the full pass-through coming in this quarter.

triggers.label: End-user inventory normal, no prebuying
triggers.quote: The end user levels of inventories are normal, there is no buildup or there is no shortage at the moment.

triggers.label: Raw material +5%, ~2% margin hit next quarter
triggers.quote: Out of that, we are expecting it may impact 2% of our margins in the coming quarter.

triggers.label: OHT volume +16% YoY
triggers.quote: We delivered 16% sales volume growth on a year-on-year basis.

guidance.quote: the vision statement states that INR5,000 crores revenue from On-Highway tires by 2030, we're standing on that figure.
Around additional about between INR1,500 crores to INR2,000 crores.

red_flags.label: Margin compression from raw material inflation
red_flags.quote: The margin was particularly impacted on account of raw material prices due to geopolitical situation globally and its impact on supply chain.

red_flags.label: Repeated evasion on forward guidance and FCF
red_flags.quote: I'm repeatedly saying please do not ask the forward-looking statements.

evasions.topic: Forward guidance on demand and momentum
evasions.quote: So we don't give forward-looking statements, and we'll refrain from doing the same.
So under the current volatility, we can't make any comments on future going statement.

evasions.topic: FCF and capital return post capex
evasions.quote: I can't comment on those things because Board has to take decisions on whatever the Board decides.
Disha, sorry, we do not share our margin figures with the channel.

summary.headline: Balkrishna Q1 FY27 OHT volume rose 16% YoY to 93,770 MT, but standalone EBITDA margin fell to 20.61% on raw-material inflation.
summary.overview: Management reported record OHT sales volume of 93,770 MT (up 16% YoY) and standalone revenue of INR3,409 crores (up 24% YoY). Standalone EBITDA was INR703 crores at a 20.61% margin, pressured by raw-material costs linked to geopolitical disruption, partly offset by a ~5% price hike. PAT was INR432 crores. The On-Highway business (truck-bus radial and 2-wheeler) went live in Q1 and is being seeded, with a ramp expected from Q2; management declined to disclose its revenue or volume.

segments.name: Off-Highway Tyres (OHT)
segments.commentary: Record quarterly volume, up 16% YoY, with India at roughly 40% of volumes. Management attributed the margin dip partly to India's higher volume mix, which it said is marginally lower-margin than exports.

segments.name: On-Highway (TBR and 2-wheeler)
segments.commentary: Launched in Q1 through distributors set up in April; management calls it small and will not disclose revenue or volume. Target of INR5,000 crores On-Highway revenue by 2030 was reiterated; FY27 is described as a portfolio-building year and FY28 as the start of serious business.

segments.name: Carbon Black
segments.commentary: Third-party sales about 10% of the business; Phase II commissioned at Bhuj, lifting capacity to 360,000 MTPA at INR800 crores. Captive power raised to 64 MW (INR125 crores). New business head appointed effective 3 July 2026.

guidance_outlook: Price hike of about 5% taken during Q1, with full pass-through expected in Q1; further price actions not yet announced.
Raw-material costs up about 5%, translating to roughly 3% on selling price; management expects about 2 percentage points of margin impact in the coming quarter (Q2), with some impact in Q3.
Balance capex of about INR3,000 crores to be spent; INR1,500-2,000 crores expected in FY27 on top of INR1,000 crores in Q1.
Management expects a better EUR-INR hedge rate for FY27 but did not disclose rates; Q1 euro rate was about INR102.
On-Highway ramp-up expected from Q2 FY27, with production and sales to proceed as planned.
capex_capacity: Carbon Black new line commissioned at Bhuj: capacity to 360,000 MTPA at INR800 crores capital outlay.
Bhuj power capacity raised from 40 MW to 64 MW at INR125 crores.
Balance capex of about INR3,000 crores under way and on schedule; total capex plan to 2030 of INR6,800 crores, of which about INR3,800 crores spent.
demand_pricing: India market share around 18-19% and US share about 3-4%; Europe share roughly 7-8%.
Management said end-user and dealer inventories are normal, with no pre-buying seen in Europe.
Europe grew on a low base and a good monsoon-linked agri season; weather risk in Europe and a 'sketchy' monsoon in India flagged as watch items.
US tariff settled at about 10%; management expects US revenue share to recover toward 15-16% from about 11-12% and called the Americas a long growth runway.
India growth attributed to agri, industrial construction and mining, mainly replacement demand.
Freight: management indicated freight costs could rise further if the geopolitical situation persists.

qa_highlights.question: What drove the India and Europe growth, and what is the price increase and commodity impact?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said India is gaining share with a broad mix across agri, mining and industrial construction. It took about a 5% price hike in Q1; raw-material inflation of about 5% is expected to hit margins by about 2 points in the coming quarter.

qa_highlights.question: Is there a US tariff refund claim in process?
qa_highlights.answer: Management confirmed that the company has applied for refunds like other companies, but said it is too early to say when the money will come.

qa_highlights.question: Capex profile for FY27 and beyond?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said INR1,500-2,000 crores more will be spent in FY27 on top of INR1,000 crores already spent, and the balance of the INR6,800 crore plan will decline thereafter.

qa_highlights.question: Why did employee costs rise 18% YoY?
qa_highlights.answer: The CFO-side answer cited a Gujarat minimum-wage increase, staff increments, and hiring for new businesses; management expects this to normalise as new-business turnover builds.

qa_highlights.question: Will OHT margins and FY28 free cash flow improve?
qa_highlights.answer: Management declined to give forward-looking comments on margins, FY28 cash flow or capital returns, citing current volatility and Board discretion.

risks_watch: Raw-material and freight inflation: about 2 points of margin hit expected in Q2, with possible further freight increases.
Pace of On-Highway ramp-up from Q2 and its effect on EBITDA-to-PAT conversion, which management expects to improve.
US tariff refund timing and amount, with no quantification given.
Weather risk in Europe and a weak monsoon expected in India.
Competitive pressure in India as the company builds a distributor network against established players; dealer margin strategy not disclosed.
summary.management_tone: Confident on volume and India/Europe momentum, but guarded on margins and forward guidance: management repeatedly declined forward-looking questions on pricing, margins, cash flow and capital returns, and gave no On-Highway financials.
key_quotes: We delivered our highest quarterly sales volume in OHT segment.
The margin was particularly impacted on account of raw material prices due to geopolitical situation globally and its impact on supply chain.

financial_highlights.metric: Realised forex loss included in sales

adds.what: Carbon Black Phase II line at Bhuj, lifting capacity to 360,000 MTPA
Bhuj captive power raised from 40 MW to 64 MW
Balance capex projects of about INR3,000 crores under way on schedule (part of INR6,800 crores plan to 2030)
On-Highway TBR and 2-wheeler business, launched in Q1 via distributors, ramp from Q2 FY27

growth.why: Q1 standalone revenue rose 24% YoY to INR3,409 crores and OHT volume rose 16% with inflation-led pricing; On-Highway ramp from Q2 and INR5,000 crore 2030 target are reiterated, but the 24% is a single-quarter YoY rate and the margin is under pressure, so the outlook is moderately positive rather than strong.
